metadata.title: Best DIWALI Special HOME Made SWEETS/मिठाई l Flaxseeds + Sattu Ladoo Recipe + Motichur Cake
metadata.description:
This Diwali, join us as we dive into the kitchens of two remarkable home bakery enterprises, each bringing unique flavors to the festive season.

Our first stop was with the mother-daughter duo, Jasween and Manjeet, beloved in their neighborhood for their mouthwatering ladoos, brownies, pinnis etc. They blend tradition with creativity, crafting a wide range of sweets both timeless and modern. We got a sneak peek into the making of their famous sattu and flaxseed ladoos, packed with earthy flavors and wholesome goodness. Jasween and Manjeet’s endeavour is rooted in passion, celebrating both tradition and innovation in every bite.

Next, we visited Jassimran Kohli, founder of Brookies, a home bakery that blossomed during the Covid lockdown and has since become a cherished venture. For Diwali, she’s created a delightful lafoo cake and a rich pistachio milk cake, both of which bring a fresh twist to festive sweets. The ladoo cake here brings the nostalgic warmth of traditional ladoos into a soft, cake-like texture, combining nutty flavors with hints of cardamom, saffron, and ghee. The pistachio milk cake captures the essence of Indian milk-based sweets in a soft, luxuriously creamy form, blending pistachio and dairy flavors into an indulgent, comforting treat. Brookies has become a go-to for those seeking unique flavours and heartfelt baking.

Watch this fun episode till the end and savor the magic of Diwali with these refreshing, one-of-a-kind treats. If you’re looking to try something truly different this Diwali, these home bakers are the ones to watch!
